---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a defensive, testable investigation improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Analyst problem

Which network-investigation question would this help answer?

## Suggested behavior

What CLI, JSON, report or parser change do you propose?

## Evidence and limitations

Which observable protocol fields or safe synthetic capture would support the finding? How might benign traffic trigger false positives?

## Privacy and compatibility

Would the change require new dependencies, network access, additional sensitive fields, or a minimum TShark version?

## Tests

Describe how it could be validated offline.

Please do not include private PCAPs, credentials or exploit-sensitive information.
